key.name: preferences-advanced
key.description: Choose between shared controls and individual surface settings.

key.name: enable-dock-glass
key.description: Whether to apply the liquid glass effect to the dash to dock.

key.name: dock-brightness
key.description: Adjusts the overall brightness of the dock.

key.name: dock-contrast
key.description: Adjusts the contrast of the dock.

key.name: dock-saturation
key.description: Adjusts the saturation of the dock.

key.name: menu-grow-from-button
key.summary: Grow the menu out of its button
key.description: While animations are on, the glass leaves the button as a drop and stretches into the menu, and goes back into the button when the menu closes.

key.name: menu-animation-interval-ms
key.description: Minimum time between open/close animation updates. The animation is driven by the frame clock, so anything up to one frame (16) means every frame; 33 and 50 cap it at 30 and 20 fps.

key.name: menu-adaptive-text-preference
key.description: Which text color to settle on when the background does not clearly favour either one: "auto", "light" or "dark".

key.name: enable-keyboard-menu-glass
key.description: Applies the panel menu glass to the keyboard layout menu, when that indicator is present.

key.name: enable-vitals-menu-glass
key.description: Applies the panel menu glass to the Vitals extension menu, when that extension is running.

key.name: enable-extra-menu-glass
key.summary: Glass for additional top panel menus
key.description: Automatically apply glass to detected panel dropdowns. Calendar and Quick Settings have separate controls.

key.name: enable-dump-shortcut
key.description: Registers dump-loop-keybinding (Ctrl+Alt+L by default). Off by default so it cannot collide with the user's own shortcuts; turn it on only when capturing a problem for a bug report.

key.name: dump-loop-keybinding
key.description: Starts a 100 ms interval dump of every live glass into the journal for 60 seconds, or stops one already running.

key.name: disabled-extra-menus
key.description: Panel indicator names disabled individually in preferences.

key.name: blur-my-shell-popup-blur
key.summary: Blur my Shell is blurring popups
key.description: Written by the shell at runtime so the preferences window can warn that Blur my Shell's popup blur shows through the glass.

key.name: detected-extra-menus
key.description: Written by the shell at runtime so the preferences window can offer a toggle only for menus that actually exist.

key.name: panel-menu-grow-from-button
key.summary: Grow the menu out of its button
key.description: While animations are on, the glass leaves the button as a drop and stretches into the menu, and goes back into the button when the menu closes.

key.name: panel-menu-animation-interval-ms
key.description: Minimum time between open/close animation updates. The animation is driven by the frame clock, so anything up to one frame (16) means every frame; 33 and 50 cap it at 30 and 20 fps.

key.name: panel-menu-scale
key.description: Scales the whole panel menu, including its glass, like zooming a window. 1.0 is the size GNOME renders.

key.name: panel-menu-settled-height-scale
key.description: Cache, not a preference. Quick Settings reports no height until it has been opened once, so the ratio can only be measured after that; it is kept here so later sessions do not have to guess. 0 means not measured yet.

key.name: panel-menu-match-quick-settings-height
key.description: Scales the panel menu so its opened height matches the Quick Settings menu, so the two panel dropdowns line up. Overrides the manual scale.

key.name: panel-menu-adaptive-text-preference
key.description: Which text color to settle on when the background does not clearly favour either one: "auto", "light" or "dark".

key.name: menu-settled-height-scale
key.description: Cache, not a preference. Quick Settings reports no height until it has been opened once, so the ratio can only be measured after that; it is kept here so later sessions do not have to guess. 0 means not measured yet.

key.name: menu-match-quick-settings-height
key.description: Scales the panel menu so its opened height matches the Quick Settings menu, so the two panel dropdowns line up. Overrides the manual scale.

key.name: menu-scale
key.description: Scales the whole panel menu, including its glass, like zooming a window. 1.0 is the size GNOME renders.

key.name: menu-brightness
key.description: Adjusts the overall brightness of the menu.

key.name: menu-contrast
key.description: Adjusts the contrast of the menu.

key.name: menu-saturation
key.description: Adjusts the saturation of the menu.

key.name: notification-adaptive-text-preference
key.description: Which text color to settle on when the background does not clearly favour either one: "auto", "light" or "dark".

key.name: notification-brightness
key.description: Adjusts the overall brightness of the notifications.

key.name: notification-contrast
key.description: Adjusts the contrast of the notifications.

key.name: notification-saturation
key.description: Adjusts the saturation of the notifications.

key.name: enable-quick-settings-glass
key.summary: Enable glass effect for Quick Settings

key.name: quick-settings-animation-interval-ms
key.description: Minimum time between open/close animation updates. The animation is driven by the frame clock, so anything up to one frame (16) means every frame; 33 and 50 cap it at 30 and 20 fps.

key.name: quick-settings-adaptive-text-preference
key.description: Which text color to settle on when the background does not clearly favour either one: "auto", "light" or "dark".

key.name: quick-settings-tint-strength
key.description: How strongly quick-settings-tint-color is applied. Independent of quick-settings-toggle-tint-strength.

key.name: quick-settings-brightness
key.description: Adjusts the overall brightness of the quick settings.

key.name: quick-settings-contrast
key.description: Adjusts the contrast of the quick settings.

key.name: quick-settings-saturation
key.description: Adjusts the saturation of the quick settings.

key.name: quick-settings-apply-to
key.description: 0 = Background (whole panel), 1 = Toggles (individual toggle buttons only)

key.name: quick-settings-toggle-tint-strength
key.description: How strongly each toggle's own original color is applied, independently of quick-settings-tint-strength. 0 applies none of it, 1 applies it fully. Only used when quick-settings-apply-to is Toggles.

key.name: quick-settings-toggle-corner-radius
key.description: Corner radius applied to each individual toggle's glass shape. Only used when quick-settings-apply-to is Toggles.

key.name: osd-adaptive-text-preference
key.description: Which text color to settle on when the background does not clearly favour either one: "auto", "light" or "dark".

key.name: osd-brightness
key.description: Adjusts the overall brightness of the on-screen displays.

key.name: osd-contrast
key.description: Adjusts the contrast of the on-screen displays.

key.name: osd-saturation
key.description: Adjusts the saturation of the on-screen displays.

key.name: enable-application-glass
key.summary: Enable glass effect for application windows
key.description: Apply the liquid glass effect to whitelisted application windows.

key.name: application-glass-all-windows
key.description: Apply the glass effect to all application windows, bypassing the whitelist.

key.name: application-window-whitelist
key.description: WM_CLASS names (from xprop) that receive the glass effect. Only listed windows are affected when "apply to all windows" is off.

key.name: application-window-blacklist
key.description: WM_CLASS names that never receive the glass effect. Only consulted when "apply to all windows" is on.

key.name: application-content-opacity
key.description: Opacity of the window content layer to let the glass effect show through (0.0 to 1.0).

key.name: application-brightness
key.description: Adjusts the brightness of the glass effect behind application windows.

key.name: application-contrast
key.description: Adjusts the contrast of the glass effect behind application windows.

key.name: application-saturation
key.description: Adjusts the saturation of the glass effect behind application windows.

key.name: enable-desktop-menu-glass
key.summary: Enable glass effect for the desktop menu
key.description: Apply the liquid glass effect to the menu that opens when you right-click the desktop. Independent of the application window glass.

key.name: desktop-menu-content-opacity
key.description: Opacity of the menu's own content layer to let the glass effect show through (0.0 to 1.0).

key.name: desktop-menu-brightness
key.description: Adjusts the brightness of the glass effect behind the desktop menu.

key.name: desktop-menu-contrast
key.description: Adjusts the contrast of the glass effect behind the desktop menu.

key.name: desktop-menu-saturation
key.description: Adjusts the saturation of the glass effect behind the desktop menu.

key.name: glass-blur-downscale
key.description: Divisor for the resolution the background blur is computed at. 2 = half resolution (default). 4 = quarter resolution: every blur pass touches a quarter as many pixels and uses a quarter of the texture memory, but the blur becomes visibly coarser and fine detail behind the glass is lost. Any other value is treated as 2.

key.name: blur-method
key.description: 0 = Gaussian Blur (Recommended), 1 = Dual Kawase (Performance)

key.name: glass-max-z
key.description: Controls the physical thickness or depth of the glass effect.

key.name: glass-displacement-scale
key.description: Controls the strength of the light refraction distortion.

key.name: glass-edge-smoothing
key.description: Geometry anti-aliasing feathering width for the glass edges.

key.name: glass-profile-shape-n
key.description: Controls the superellipse profile shape of the glass surface curvature.

key.name: glass-ior
key.description: Simulates the material's optical density (glass is typically 1.5 - 2.4).

key.name: glass-chroma-strength
key.description: RGB color separation caused by refraction, as a fraction of the refraction's displacement: blue is shifted that much further than green, and red that much less.

key.name: glass-corner-smoothing
key.description: 0 gives circular corners. Higher values give continuous corners whose curve starts up to (1 + value) times the corner radius from the corner, keeping the corner's midpoint in place. Application windows always keep circular corners.

key.name: glass-backdrop-highlights
key.description: Tints the edge light, highlights and sheen with the color behind the glass instead of plain white.

key.name: glass-specular-intensity
key.description: The brightness of specular highlights on the glass surface.

key.name: glass-shininess
key.description: Controls the sharpness of the specular reflections.

key.name: glass-rim-width
key.description: The width of the rim lighting band near the edges.

key.name: glass-rim-intensity
key.description: The overall brightness of the rim lighting.

key.name: glass-rim-directional-power
key.description: Controls how the light direction affects the rim mask.

key.name: glass-rim-power
key.description: Controls the Fresnel effect falloff for the rim light.

key.name: glass-rim-light-color-intensity
key.description: Multiplier for the rim light color brightness.

key.name: glass-sheen-intensity
key.description: The intensity of the background sheen across the glass surface.

key.name: glass-light-angle-deg
key.description: The directional angle of the virtual light source illuminating the glass.

key.name: shadow-radius
key.description: How far the drop shadow extends past the glass edge. Helps the glass stay visible on light backgrounds (e.g. white). Set to 0 to disable.

key.name: shadow-intensity
key.description: How dark the drop shadow is. 0.0 = invisible, 1.0 = maximum darkness. Helps the glass stay visible on light backgrounds (e.g. white).

key.name: output-logs
key.description: Output logs to the terminal.

key.name: glass-debug-diagnostics
key.description: Collect the per-paint state that global._lgGlass.dump() reports (backdrop copy, blur and composite rects, texture pool, blur result). This runs on every paint of every glass surface, so it costs performance even when logging is off. Leave this disabled unless you are debugging a rendering problem.

key.name: top-bar-style
key.description: "off" keeps the top bar as the theme draws it, "pill" puts one glass pill across it, "islands" puts a pill behind each of its three groups of buttons.

key.name: top-bar-corner-radius
key.description: Anything from half the bar's height up makes round ends.

key.name: top-bar-margin-top
key.description: Space between the pills and the screen's edge; the bar grows to make room for it.

key.name: top-bar-margin-bottom
key.description: Space between the pills and the screen's edge; the bar grows to make room for it.

key.name: top-bar-margin-left
key.description: Space between the pills and the screen's edge; the bar grows to make room for it.

key.name: top-bar-margin-right
key.description: Space between the pills and the screen's edge; the bar grows to make room for it.

key.name: top-bar-padding-top
key.description: Space between the pills' edge and the buttons inside them.

key.name: top-bar-padding-bottom
key.description: Space between the pills' edge and the buttons inside them.

key.name: top-bar-padding-left
key.description: Space between the pills' edge and the buttons inside them.

key.name: top-bar-padding-right
key.description: Space between the pills' edge and the buttons inside them.

key.name: top-bar-enable-adaptive-text-color
key.summary: Adapt the top bar's text color to what is behind it

key.name: top-bar-sample-interval-ms
key.summary: How often the top bar's text color is checked (ms)

key.name: top-bar-adaptive-text-preference
key.description: "light" or "dark" decides when both are equally readable; "auto" favours neither.

key.name: desktop-widgets
key.description: Which widgets are shown: "weather", "events" (up next) and "media" (now playing).

key.name: media-visualizer
key.summary: Bars that follow the sound on the Now Playing widget
key.description: While a player plays, the widget listens to the default output and shows its loudness in five bands. GNOME shows the microphone indicator while it listens.

key.name: desktop-widgets-position
key.description: "top-left", "top-right", "bottom-left", "bottom-right" or "center" of the primary monitor. A widget that was dragged stays where it was dropped.

key.name: desktop-widget-anchors
key.summary: Where single widgets are stacked instead
key.description: JSON: widget id to "top-left", "top-right", "bottom-left", "bottom-right" or "center", for the widgets put somewhere other than desktop-widgets-position from their menu.

key.name: desktop-item-positions
key.description: JSON: item id to the fraction [x, y] of the work area its center was dropped at.

key.name: weather-place
key.description: Name, latitude and longitude of a place found in the preferences. Empty: the location set in GNOME Weather.

key.name: weather-temperature-unit
key.description: "auto", "celsius" or "fahrenheit".

key.name: desktop-widget-enable-adaptive-text-color
key.summary: Adapt the desktop items' text color to what is behind them

key.name: desktop-widget-sample-interval-ms
key.summary: How often the desktop items' text color is checked (ms)

key.name: desktop-widget-adaptive-text-preference
key.description: "light" or "dark" decides when both are equally readable; "auto" favours neither.

key.name: enable-glass-clock
key.summary: Show a clock with glass digits on the desktop

key.name: glass-clock-position
key.description: "top-left", "top-right", "bottom-left", "bottom-right" or "center" of the primary monitor, unless it was dragged.

key.name: glass-clock-font
key.description: A font description without a size, such as "Cantarell Bold": one of the fonts the extension ships (Antonio, Barlow Condensed, Saira Extra Condensed, Sofia Sans Extra Condensed) with a weight (Light, Regular, SemiBold, Bold), or any installed font. Empty uses the interface font in bold.

key.name: glass-clock-size
key.summary: Size of the glass clock's digits (px)

key.name: glass-clock-stretch
key.summary: Width of the glass clock's digits, relative to their height

key.name: glass-clock-tall-style
key.summary: How the glass clock's digits are made taller
key.description: "even": the digits grow evenly, every stroke keeping its width. "upright": mostly their straight upright strokes grow, while curves, bars and the colon's dots keep their shape; the parts above and below a join in the middle grow alike.

key.name: glass-clock-height
key.summary: Height of the glass clock's digits, relative to the font
key.description: Above 1 the digits are made taller as glass-clock-tall-style says, every stroke keeping its width.

key.name: glass-clock-format
key.description: "system" follows the clock format in Settings, "24h" or "12h".

key.name: glass-clock-show-date
key.summary: Show the date above the glass clock

key.name: enable-launcher
key.description: A search field on glass in the middle of the screen, opened with the launcher shortcut. It shows the same results as the overview's search.

key.name: launcher-enable-adaptive-text-color
key.summary: Adapt the launcher's text color to what is behind it

key.name: launcher-sample-interval-ms
key.summary: How often the launcher's text color is checked (ms)

key.name: launcher-adaptive-text-preference
key.description: "light" or "dark" decides when both are equally readable; "auto" favours neither.
